changes.title: Time machine: 1971 to 2040
changes.summary: Drag through the years and the site follows: the map, every topic page, the company explorer and the roadmap. History to 2026, labelled plans and projections after. Three new facts on design costs and the transistor trend.

changes.title: From simulation to real silicon
changes.summary: Every tiny-chip design now exports as a ready Tiny Tapeout project: Verilog, info.yaml, a cocotb test and the gate netlist. CI checks every export with Icarus Verilog and Yosys. Four facts on shuttles, costs and the open flow.

changes.title: Build the CPU from your own gates
changes.summary: New tiny-chip project: one bit of an ALU. The RISC-V lab chains 32 copies and runs every add, compare and branch on your gates. A bug in your slice, or a planted factory defect, breaks the CPU.

changes.title: Every chip, not only AI chips
changes.summary: The lab now covers every kind of chip. New topic Chips everywhere: look inside a phone, car, thermostat, laptop and AI server, and match jobs to the right kind of chip. Seven new facts on chip sales, units, end markets and car chips.

changes.title: One project: Open Silicon Lab
changes.summary: Silicon Journey Lab and Open Silicon Quest merged into one open-source project with a connected chip-stack map. Facts now live in this file and are updated by pull request.
Added Google TPU Ironwood, AWS Trainium3, Microsoft Maia 200, Cerebras CS-4, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPU, TPU 8t/8i and Trainium4, and updated AMD MI455X to 23.3 TB/s and 320 billion transistors.
changes.title: Eight AI-chip facts added
